3. 'Structural collapse' (Hands/Glove): The Router assigned Severity 2.0. This suggests the 'muddy' interface noted by the Router is part of a broader anatomical ambiguity or fusion issue that the pose model struggled to resolve. I am upgrading the significance of this defect, though keeping the severity rating moderate as no extra limbs are visually obvious.
